data.body: Additional 2026-09-05 reproduction on origin/main@84ef2848: async plan-review job 1788646952249553441-7b549d5249534992bf46536eab010ec1 for cloudy-primitive-scaup remains `running`, while gate_status reports a local signed_at/verified_at result but durable verdict `stale-store` because the MCP clone diverged. The shared-store repo-venv `review-plan --status` remains unsigned. gate_status calls take roughly 90–150 seconds. This demonstrates an ambiguous split-brain outcome: billable review work completed in the MCP clone but cannot certify the shared ticket, and the handle does not become terminal promptly. No duplicate gate was started.
